name: MOBA L1 charge skill 1 + walk
intent: Hold L1 to charge skill 1, release L1 to cast, left stick still moves the champion at the same time.
ios_limitation: iOS AssistiveTouch / virtual mouse is one pointer. Holding L1 occupies that pointer, so the stick cannot move at the same time. Charge-while-walking is not reliably possible on iOS.

keys.notes: Map onto the in-game movement wheel (bottom-left). Must stay a joystick, not D-pad clicks. Must NOT be stolen when L1 is held.

keys.press: touch DOWN on skill 1 icon — start charge
keys.hold: keep that same finger down — keep charging
keys.notes: One dedicated finger on skill 1. Do not attach this key to the left stick.

forbidden_l1_types.why: Auto-taps instead of holding. Charge never builds, and tap stream fights the stick.

forbidden_l1_types.vi_menu: Vuốt thẳng / Click on the straight
forbidden_l1_types.why: Fixed-duration swipe, not hold-time. Occupies the pointer for a scripted drag so you cannot walk for that whole swipe.
FPS fire/recoil. Tap speed or recoil slide replaces a real hold.
Macros run a timed sequence on one pointer. Hold duration is not your finger, and movement is usually blocked until the macro finishes.

forbidden_l1_types.vi_menu: Liên kết joystick / skill joystick ăn stick trái
forbidden_l1_types.why: Holding L1 hijacks the left stick to aim the skill. That is the exact 'cannot walk while charging' bug.

expect: Hold L1: a touch marker stays on skill 1 and does not lift until you release L1.
While L1 is still down, move the left stick: a second marker must move on the movement wheel.
Release L1: skill-1 marker lifts (cast). Stick marker is unaffected.
